name: Nu i kak otmyt' kvartiru, kogda sosed - grjaznulja-prizrak?
original_name: Ну и как отмыть квартиру, когда сосед — грязнуля–призрак?
source:
In search for a cheap house, you can turn a blind eye to dirt, stench, and even strange neighbors. But they say that house I am going to move to has a ghost! What nonsense! Ghosts do not exist. And if they appear, my dolly will quickly grind them into a washing powder, and then take the rent.

Main character is the android maid Katty, who has a lot of work to do. 

[From [url=https://srandom.itch.io/how-should-i-keep-a-house-squeaky-clean-with-a-filthy-little-neighbour-ghost-dem]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
为了寻找便宜的房子，你可以对污垢、恶臭甚至陌生的邻居视而不见。但他们说我要搬去的房子里有鬼！胡说八道！鬼魂并不存在。如果它们出现，我的小娃娃会迅速将它们磨成洗衣粉，然后收取租金。

主角是机器人女仆凯蒂，她有很多工作要做。

[来自[url=https://srandom.itch.io/how-should-i-keep-a-house-squeaky-clean-with-a-filthy-little-neighbour-ghost-dem]itch.io[/url]]
